stem: Which issue was a factor in the formation of the Federalist Party during the early republic era?

options.label: A
options.text: Disagreements over how much the national government should collect in taxes

options.label: B
options.text: Disagreements over how much state governments should regulate manufacturing

options.label: C
options.text: Disagreements over the role that state governments should have in ratifying treaties

options.label: D
options.text: Disagreements over the role that the national government should have in printing currency
